purpose: Prompt-only illustrative location painting; no image references or documentary fidelity claim.
prompt:
Create a breathtaking original watercolor and gouache landscape illustration for an illustrated travel journal about Tà Xùa in northern Vietnam. Work entirely from this written description. Exquisite fine botanical brushwork, deep atmospheric perspective, translucent pigment blooms, subtle cold-press paper tooth, luminous light, sophisticated rich jade and indigo shadows against pearl and apricot sky. A real painter's composed landscape with immense scale and authentic subtropical Vietnamese uplands, never generic Alpine peaks. Hand-painted, not photographic, not 3D, not flat cartoon, not a collage. Fill the entire canvas edge to edge; no lettering, logos, sign text, people, borders, frames, website elements, blank paper, or watermarks. Sharp authored detail where land meets light; do not blur or wash out the whole scene. The sky is luminous and quietly colored, never empty white.
Landscape canvas, strictly 16:9 widescreen composition. Keep the upper 48 percent and upper left calm for dark journal text, with soft pale atmosphere; strongest landmarks and detailed foreground in the lower central-right. All critical silhouettes fit inside the middle 70 percent of width and y=0.50..0.94, so cropping to 16:10 or 4:3 keeps them intact. Extend coherent scenery to both edges.
Mỏm Cá Heo: a striking weathered dark slate rock outcrop with two enormous naturally stacked angular slabs on a grassy mountainside. The upper stone cantilevers horizontally into open air, its tapered blunt curved tip suggesting a dolphin's snout, not an actual animal. This must look like geological rock with believable weight, rough fine strata, moss seams and warm lichen. The silhouette projects left from the right-hand slope, above spectacular forested folded valleys disappearing into a distant ocean of pale clouds. Golden late-afternoon rim light, cool blue shadows and apricot sky. Concentrate the recognizable rock in the central-right lower portion, with its entire outline inside x=0.36 to 0.82 and y=0.56 to 0.87, not cut off.
